name: Ready-to-Use 3D Furniture Configurator by Lunfio
author: lunfio

sections.description:
Ready-to-Use 3D Furniture Configurator by Lunfio lets furniture businesses add a finished WebGL configurator to WordPress without rebuilding the website or paying for a custom software project.

Lunfio is built for fitted wardrobes, walk-in wardrobes, media walls, cabinets, closets, modular storage, and made-to-measure furniture. It is a ready-to-use, all-included hosted product: customer configurator, website embed, admin dashboard, materials, colors, pricing, branding, quote/order requests, hosting, updates, and support.

This is not just a 3D viewer. Lunfio is a sales tool designed to turn passive furniture website visitors into serious quote requests. Instead of receiving vague messages like “How much would this cost?”, your team receives a structured request with selected size, layout, material, color, options, and customer details.

Why furniture businesses use Lunfio:

  • Let customers design visually before they contact you.
  • Collect clearer quote and order requests from your own website.
  • Reduce back-and-forth before preparing a useful quote.
  • Show wardrobes, cabinets, closets, media walls, and storage options in WebGL 3D.
  • Use your own materials, colors, pricing rules, brand style, and sales process.
  • Keep your existing WordPress site, payments, CRM, quote process, and customer workflow.
  • Avoid a long custom 3D development project.
  • Launch with a ready setup, then customize branding, textures, models, and integrations when needed.

What Lunfio includes:

  • Customer-facing WebGL 3D furniture configurator.
  • WordPress shortcode and iframe embed.
  • Lunfio admin dashboard.
  • Material, color, finish, and price setup.
  • Branding and visual customization options.
  • Quote/order request flow.
  • Hosting, updates, device compatibility, and support.

Best fit:

  • Wardrobe companies and fitted furniture businesses.
  • Cabinet makers, closet companies, and storage furniture sellers.
  • Media wall and TV unit installers.
  • Furniture manufacturers and showrooms.
  • Ecommerce teams selling configurable furniture.
  • Web studios and agencies serving furniture clients.

The WordPress plugin connects your site to an approved Lunfio account, checks subscription status, syncs the iframe token, and gives you a shortcode for placement. Product setup, materials, pricing, branding, and advanced 3D options are managed in the full Lunfio dashboard so WordPress stays clean and fast.

Live demo and video: https://lunf.io/

External services

This plugin connects to the Lunfio hosted service at https://lunf.io/ and to Lunfio’s Supabase backend at https://dzgwebloypxcnwyyrecv.supabase.co.

The plugin sends the site administrator’s Lunfio login details to Supabase only when the administrator connects the account. The password is used to create a session and is not stored in WordPress. The plugin stores the returned session token, refresh token, workspace status, and iframe token so it can sync access and render the configurator.

The public shortcode renders an iframe from https://lunf.io/embed.html with the iframe token. The full dashboard shortcode renders an iframe from the Lunfio admin URL.

Lunfio privacy policy: https://lunf.io/privacy.html

Setup

  1. Request or approve a Lunfio setup for the furniture business.
  2. Open the Lunfio menu in WordPress admin.
  3. Sign in with the Lunfio login sent after setup approval.
  4. Sync status and token.
  5. Add [lunfio_configurator] to a page.

Optional shortcode:

[lunfio_configurator height="1000" radius="12"]

Dashboard wrapper shortcode:

[lunfio_dashboard]<h3>Notes</h3>

Materials, pricing, branding, product colors, order flow, and advanced 3D setup are managed in the full Lunfio admin dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip in WordPress admin, or install it from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the Lunfio menu in WordPress admin.
  4. Sign in with the Lunfio login sent after setup approval.
  5. Sync status and token.
  6. Add [lunfio_configurator] to a page, post, or shortcode block.
sections.faq:
Who is this plugin for?

It is for furniture businesses and agencies that need a working online configurator for fitted wardrobes, walk-in wardrobes, cabinets, closets, media walls, storage furniture, or other configurable furniture products.

What does ready-to-use mean?

The configurator is already built, hosted, maintained, and designed for furniture quote requests. You do not need to build a WebGL application from scratch. Lunfio can start with a ready setup and then be customized for your brand, materials, prices, textures, models, and sales workflow.

Is Lunfio only a 3D configurator?

No. Lunfio is a ready-to-use furniture sales tool with WebGL configuration, website embed, admin dashboard, material and pricing setup, branding options, structured customer requests, hosting, updates, and support.

How does it help sales and quotes?

Lunfio helps customers explain what they want before your team replies. They select the product visually, choose dimensions, materials, colors, and options, then send a structured request. Your team starts from clearer information instead of a vague message.

Do I need a Lunfio account?

Yes. The plugin is an interface for the hosted Lunfio configurator service. A Lunfio account and approved workspace are required before the iframe token can sync.

Does the plugin store my Lunfio password?

No. The password is sent only when connecting the account. WordPress stores the returned session token and refresh token so the plugin can sync status and iframe access.

Can I manage materials, pricing, colors, and 3D options in WordPress?

Those settings are managed in the full Lunfio admin dashboard, not inside WordPress. The WordPress plugin is for connecting the site, syncing access, placing the shortcode, and previewing the embed.

Which shortcode should I use?

Use [lunfio_configurator] for the customer-facing configurator. Use [lunfio_dashboard] only if you want to embed the Lunfio dashboard inside a private WordPress admin or internal page.

What problem does Lunfio solve?

Many furniture website visitors leave because they cannot easily explain what they want. Lunfio lets them design the furniture visually, choose the key options, and send you a clearer quote or order request.

What result can we expect?

Lunfio helps turn passive visitors into serious inquiries. Instead of vague messages, you receive structured requests with size, material, color, options, and customer details already selected.

Do we need to rebuild our website?

No. Lunfio is embedded into your existing website. You copy and paste one embed code, similar to adding a YouTube video.

Will it match our brand?

Yes. Lunfio can use your logo, colors, materials, pricing, and visual style so the configurator feels like part of your own website.

Who maintains it?

We maintain it for you. Hosting, updates, compatibility improvements, uptime, support, and ongoing product improvements are included from $49/month.

Is this just another subscription?

No. You are paying for a working sales tool, hosting, support, updates, and continued compatibility across devices and browsers. You do not need to hire developers to maintain a custom configurator yourself.

Will it break our website?

No. Lunfio runs inside an isolated embed. Your existing website stays separate. If you remove the embed code, your site returns to normal.

Do we need 3D models?

No. You can start with the ready Lunfio setup. Custom models, textures, and advanced branding can be added later if needed.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. Lunfio is designed for desktop and mobile visitors, so customers can configure furniture from the device they are already using.

Can it integrate with our current sales process?

Yes. Lunfio sends structured requests that your team can handle in your existing process. You can continue using your current payment, quote, CRM, or manual sales workflow.

Can we use our own prices and materials?

Yes. You can configure materials, colors, prices, and available options for your business.

Can we just build this with AI?

A simple demo can be generated quickly, but a stable furniture configurator is much harder. Real furniture configuration needs polished UI, 3D graphics, option logic, browser and device testing, order flow, maintenance, and support. Lunfio already gives you a tested system, so you do not need to spend months building and fixing one from scratch.

How fast can we launch?

You can test the embed immediately. For a business setup, send us your product type, materials, and branding needs. We help you choose the fastest setup path.

Can agencies use Lunfio for clients?

Yes. Agencies can add Lunfio to furniture, interior, ecommerce, or home-improvement client websites without building a custom configurator from scratch.

Can we get a custom or boxed version?

Yes. Contact us if you need a custom setup, special integration, or boxed/private version.
